Fact.Sale.description: One row per sale line item. The main fact table for revenue, profit and sales volume analysis.

columns.[Stock Item Key]: FK to Dimension.[Stock Item] — the product sold
columns.[Invoice Date Key]: FK to Dimension.Date — date the invoice was raised
columns.[Delivery Date Key]: FK to Dimension.Date — date goods were delivered
columns.[Salesperson Key]: FK to Dimension.Employee — the salesperson who made the sale
columns.[Quantity]: Units sold on this line item
columns.[Total Excluding Tax]: Total line revenue before tax. Use this for all revenue and sales value calculations.
columns.[Profit]: Gross profit for this line ([Total Excluding Tax] minus cost of goods)

Dimension.Date.description: Date dimension. Join on [Invoice Date Key] = [Date] to filter by time periods.

columns.[Date]: The actual date value — used as the join key from Fact.Sale.[Invoice Date Key]

Dimension.Customer.description: Customer master. One row per customer.

columns.[Category]: Customer category e.g. Novelty Shop, Supermarket
columns.[Buying Group]: Buying group or chain the customer belongs to
columns.[Valid To]: Date record expired (9999-12-31 means still active)

Dimension.Employee.description: Employee and salesperson master. Filter [Is Salesperson] = 1 for sales reps only.

columns.[Is Salesperson]: 1 if this employee is a salesperson, 0 otherwise

Dimension.Stock Item.description: Product master. Note: table name has a space — use [Dimension].[Stock Item] in queries.

columns.[Selling Package]: How it is sold e.g. Each, Packet

business_glossary.date: Dimension.Date joined on Fact.Sale.[Invoice Date Key] = Dimension.Date.[Date]
business_glossary.month: Dimension.Date.[Calendar Month Number] or [Calendar Month Label]
business_glossary.quarter: Dimension.Date.[Calendar Quarter Number] or [Calendar Quarter Label]

join_keys.Fact.Sale -> Dimension.Stock Item: s.[Stock Item Key] = si.[Stock Item Key]
